title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Contract Terms: Rental Days and the Additional-Day Charge
content:
**Contract clause — rental days on a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.**

1. A rental day is the class rental period of 24 elapsed hours, counted from the actual pickup time. The rental days started are the calendar days from the actual pickup date to the actual return date, plus one more when the actual return time is later than the actual pickup time.
2. The rental days booked are counted the same way, from the scheduled pickup date and time to the scheduled return date and time.
3. The first rental day is the first-day rental fee posted when the contract opened. At check-in every rental day the contract started after its first, up to the rental days booked, is charged as an additional rental day: the additional rental days are the rental days started, taken up to the rental days booked (with the rental days booked taken as at least one), less the first day, and never fewer than zero. Each additional rental day counts as a whole day.
4. Rental days started beyond the rental days booked are late-return periods charged under the late-return rules, not additional days.
5. The additional-day charge is the class base rate (the class rental fee for one period) for each additional rental day, posted as one base rental fee line dated the actual return date with the additional days as its quantity, and rounded to the cent once, on the final amount.

## Timeline (hypothetical Bluegate Cargo Van contract; class base rate 24.95)

Picked up Monday 09:00; scheduled return Thursday 09:00, so the rental days booked are 3 (three calendar days, and 09:00 is not later than 09:00).

| Checked in | Rental days started | Additional rental days | Additional-day charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday 20:00 | 1 (0 calendar days, plus one) | 0 | None |
| Tuesday 08:00 | 1 (1 calendar day; 08:00 is not later than 09:00) | 0 | None |
| Wednesday 15:30 | 3 (2 calendar days, plus one) | 2 | 49.90 on one line dated Wednesday, quantity 2 |
| Friday 10:00 | 5 (4 calendar days, plus one) | 2 — days 4 and 5 lie beyond the 3 booked and are late-return periods | 49.90 on one line dated Friday, quantity 2 |
